{{Top}}
{{Quote|You almost got us killed. Are you brainless?''"<br />"''I spake.''"<br />"''The ability to speak does not make you intelligent.|Jar Jar Binks and Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
[[File:Brain.png|thumb|A brain]]
In most [[Species/Legends|species]], the '''brain''' was the control center of the central [[nervous system]] and it served as the center of cognitive abilities. It was found in most species in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and was usually located in the skull. Its severe injury or loss resulted in [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="MBS">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> The hypothalamus was a portion of the brain responsible certain metabolic processes that controlled particular bodily functions such as body temperature, hunger, thirst, fatigue, and [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]].<ref name="BH">{{StoryCite|story=Payback: The Tale of Dengar|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> A [[lobotomy]] was a surgical procedure performed on the brain, which often resulted in impairment or docility in the patient.<ref name="Mission from Mount Yoda">''[[Mission from Mount Yoda]]''</ref>

The [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Order]] removed the brains of enlightened monks and put them in a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] walker. Since the brain regulated virtually all of the being's activities and was the center of a being's consciousness, the [[brain transplant]]ation resulted in the movement of the monk's identity from body to droid walker. The [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] fed on the [[Soup (Anzati)|soup]], or brains, of others.

The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]' amygdala and other emotional centers of the brain had subtle behavioral adjustments mass-programmed into them, making them less independent and more effective fighters.<ref name="MBS" />

During an [[Attack on the first Death Star|attack]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] suffered a shrapnel wound to her head, forcing [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] neurosurgeon [[Abu Banu]] and Doctors [[Kornell Divini]] and [[Roa (doctor)|Roa]] to remove the piece from her brain. They identified it going into one of her two hippocampi and the adjacent cortex as well as the Cornu Ammonis fields one through three and the subiculum. They agreed that it might lead to some memory loss, as much as a full [[Standard year/Legends|standard year]].<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>
